name: @plankui/mcp

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List every PlankUI component with its slug, category and one-line description. Call this first to see what exists.

category.description: Optional: Actions, Forms, Overlays, Feedback, Display, Charts or Navigation.

tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Find components by what they do, such as 'date range', 'chat input' or 'chart'.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Get one component: install command, every file it needs with full source, usage example and props.

slug.description: Component slug, such as button or dialog.

tools.name: get_component_usage
tools.description: Get a component's usage example and props without the source. Lighter than get_component.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List the complete screen templates, such as dashboard and sign-in.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get a template's full page source and the components it is built from.

tools.name: get_setup
tools.description: Set PlankUI up in a React + Tailwind CSS v4 project: dependencies, tokens.css, styles.css and the cn helper.

tools.name: get_theming
tools.description: Themes, component styles, accents and radius: the attributes and tokens that restyle PlankUI.

instructions: PlankUI is a copy-paste React + Tailwind CSS v4 component library on Radix. Run get_setup once per project, then list_components or search_components, then get_component for each component you use. Import from @/components/ui/<slug>.
